title: ”Wyrmwood” One-shotted game on Atomos model
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
This is a one-shotted output on the latest Atomos model

I used one prompt and one reference image to get this. Tried uploading the reference image i used in the prompt, but only allowed to post video

comments.author: BlackMageX2
comments.body: In in-depth is the gameplay thus far?

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: This was the base prompt to get the world up, I’ve added a village and some NPCs just now and next step is to add a questline

replies.author: BlackMageX2
replies.body: Needs a spot where people can follow. When do anticapting on releasing

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Yeah, I’m gonna start a YouTube I think cause it’s hard to do a series people can follow here on Reddit

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
It was connected to a reference image i used, here it is:

"Attached is going to be an image. I want you to try to replicate this game one-to-one. Do everything in your power, all the tools, and everything you have available. Try to recreate it, take a look at the image, and try your best. I believe there's an axe model that we can use for the FPS of this game.”

replies.body: I just love the fact that it seemed very important to inform the AI about that they THINK there is an axe model that they can "use for the FPS of the game", what ever that means.

comments.author: phlanxcampbell1992
comments.body: How did u get the arm animations or weapon animation

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: The model found a public asset for the axe, the rest is generated by the model itself

replies.author: Melodic-Upstairs7584
replies.body: The idle animations of the axe and all the rest were one-shot generated by AI? Correct socket placement on the player character’s hands and the weapon? Fable 5 is nowhere near that, so I’m skeptical

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: This isn’t fable - it’s Atomos

comments.author: CybuhDasher
comments.body: their site sucks - half the games just don't load including yours for me.

comments.author: Time_Cat_5212
comments.body: I'm sick of seeing "one shotted" slop.  I want to see the really interesting games that people designed thoughtfully and iterated on.  Not... "omg look at what the model can do"

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: We’re still early so I think it will be a time until that happens - for now most people are just pushing models to see how far it can go

replies.author: TruWaves
replies.body: OP has a slop engine called Tesana. They created a new model i believe called Atomos which probably is a new generative ai model armed with their slop engine model. Probably they even have something of a similar demo and this Tesana just pulled that and modified it a bit.
